answer.reason: The verses tell of the ark's capture, its power at the Jordan, and its journeys to Jerusalem and the temple, so a line of its chief events can be written.

clauses.english: was borne into the Jordan, and Israel crossed on dry ground
clauses.quote: stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan

clauses.english: was taken by the Philistines in battle
clauses.quote: And the ark of God was taken

clauses.english: was brought up by David into the city of David
clauses.quote: brought up the ark of God from the house of Obededom into the city of David

clauses.english: was set in the most holy place of Solomon's temple
clauses.quote: unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place
